ctx.x: I've been Jonah ever since. But it was a great band. And it got to do little things like, you know, little mischief things, like the bass player, and I was having fun with him. I was telling him about it. We were reminiscing not too long ago, a very nice guy, he lives over in Jersey, but he's been in another business. He played with Louis Depps' band way back when Earl Hines was with him.
